reverse_chunks.old: """Held Mac-local MOOSE metadata readiness, then a separately authorized fixed assumed thermal-birth coupon."""
reverse_chunks.selected: """Held fixed SI one-way thermoelastic case; inherited Mac lifecycle, no automatic assessment."""
need(stage == "coupon", "Only the fixed thermoelastic case is available")

reverse_chunks.old:
need(c.get("schema") == "962-macos-cp1-thermal-birth-stage-actual/v1" and c.get("stage") == stage
         and c.get("root_and_peer_review_complete") is True and c.get("native_launch_authorized") is True
         and c.get("head_authorized") is False and c.get("manufacturing_authorized") is False,
         "Separate reviewed stage authority required")
    need(c.get("coupon_solve_authorized") is (stage == "coupon"), "Readiness cannot authorize the coupon")
reverse_chunks.selected:
need(stage == "coupon" and c.get("schema") == "962-macos-oneway-thermoelastic-case-actual/v1"
         and c.get("stage") == stage and c.get("root_and_peer_review_complete") is True
         and c.get("native_launch_authorized") is True and c.get("coupon_solve_authorized") is True
         and all(c.get(k) is False for k in ("head_authorized", "engineering_accepted", "physics_qualified",
                                           "material_qualified", "process_calibrated", "manufacturing_authorized",
                                           "automatic_retry")), "Separate reviewed fixed-case authority required")

reverse_chunks.old:
and "lib/combined/libheat_transfer-opt.0.dylib" in c["runtime_sha256s"],
         "Exact reviewed19 selected files/13 links including heat-transfer library required")
    need(all(c.get(k) is False for k in ["engineering_accepted", "physics_qualified", "material_qualified", "process_calibrated"])
         and c.get("automatic_retry") is False, "No qualification or retry authority")
    need("bin/combined-opt" in c["runtime_sha256s"] and c["runtime_symlinks"].get("bin/moose-opt") == "combined-opt"
         and runtime_unchanged(c) and os.access(EXECUTABLE, os.X_OK), "Actual installed runtime bindings required")
    need(c["installation_result_peer"] in pins and c["installation_receipt"] in pins,
         "Stopped installation review and receipt must be pinned")
    limits = c["resources"]
    need(set(limits) == {"wall_seconds", "sampled_RSS_stop_bytes", "sampled_output_stop_bytes"}
         and all(type(v) in (int, float) and not isinstance(v, bool) and v > 0
                 and v < float("inf") for v in limits.values()), "Explicit finite positive Mac sampled limits required")
    if stage == "coupon":
        need(limits == held["coupon_resources"], "Exact reviewed per-level coupon bounds required")
        need(all(c[k] in pins for k in ["readiness_receipt", "readiness_result_peer", "readiness_registry"]),
             "Stopped readiness, peer and exact cached registry required")
        ready = json.loads((ROOT / c["readiness_receipt"]).read_text())
        prior18 = {k: v for k, v in c["runtime_sha256s"].items() if k != "lib/combined/libheat_transfer-opt.0.dylib"}
        need(ready.get("readiness_completed") is True and len(prior18) == 18
             and ready["runtime_sha256s"] == prior18 and ready["runtime_symlinks"] == c["runtime_symlinks"]
             and all(v is True for v in ready["required_object_presence"].values())
             and pins[c["readiness_registry"]] == ready["artifact_sha256"]["registry.log"],
             "Exact old18 subset plus root-bound new heat library and cached registry required")
        registry_features((ROOT / c["readiness_registry"]).read_text())
reverse_chunks.selected:
and runtime_unchanged(c) and os.access(EXECUTABLE, os.X_OK), "Exact selected19/13 current runtime required")
    need(c["resources"] == held["coupon_resources"], "Exact100s/2GiB/512MiB fixed-case limits required")
    for key in ("installation_result_peer", "installation_receipt", "data_preparation_root_closed",
                "data_preparation_result_peer", "independent_assessment_source",
                "independent_assessment_source_peer", "independent_assessment_source_root_review"):
        need(isinstance(c.get(key), str) and c[key] in pins, "Independent installation/3D assessment source gates required")
    registry = held["registry"]
    presence = json.loads((ROOT / registry["presence_record"]).read_text())
    closed = json.loads((ROOT / registry["root_closed"]).read_text())
    need(closed.get("returncode") == 0 and closed.get("stop_reason") is None
         and closed.get("selected19_files13_links_before_after_unchanged") is True
         and closed["runtime_bindings_sha256"] == pins[registry["runtime_bindings"]]
         and closed["registry_sha256"] == pins[registry["stdout"]]
         and presence["registry_sha256"] == closed["registry_sha256"]
         and presence["root_closed_sha256"] == pins[registry["root_closed"]]
         and presence.get("all_present_once") is True and set(presence["exact_rows"]) == set(FEATURES),
         "Cached exact selected-runtime registry presence joins required; not a semantic/ABI proof")
    registry_features((ROOT / registry["stdout"]).read_text())
    manifest_path = TRANSFER / "transfer-manifest.json"
    need(c.get("transfer_manifest") == str(manifest_path.relative_to(ROOT))
         and pins.get(c["transfer_manifest"]) == c.get("transfer_manifest_sha256"), "Exact completed transfer manifest required")
    manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text())
    source_index = json.loads((PREP / "thermal-input-index.json").read_text())
    need(manifest.get("schema") == "962-oneway-thermoelastic-prepared-transfer/v1"
         and manifest["source_receipt_sha256"] == source_index["receipt_sha256"]
         and manifest["selected321"] == source_index["selected"]
         and (manifest["old_node_count"], manifest["born_reference_DOF_count"], manifest["shared_node_count"],
              manifest["genuinely_new_node_count"]) == (225, 225, 25, 200)
         and manifest.get("native_connectivity_or_ID_bijection_proven") is False
         and manifest.get("native_execution_authorized") is False, "Complete same-case data preparation required")
    need(set(manifest["table_sha256"]) == set(TRANSFER_FILES) - {"transfer-manifest.json"}, "Exactly three tables required")
    for name in TRANSFER_FILES:
        need(str((TRANSFER / name).relative_to(ROOT)) in pins, "Every converted input must be directly pinned")
        if name != "transfer-manifest.json":
            need(pins[str((TRANSFER / name).relative_to(ROOT))] == manifest["table_sha256"][name], "Converted table drift")
    frozen = json.loads(PHYSICS.read_text())
    need(frozen["card"] == json.loads(CARD.read_text()) and frozen["card_sha256"] == sha(CARD)
         and frozen["source_input_sha256"]["thermoelastic-birth.i"] == sha(CASE / "thermoelastic-birth.i"),
         "Exact separate source physics contract required")

         and not output.exists() and not output.is_symlink(), "Fresh direct task output required")

need(output == ENGINEERING / "cp1-oneway-thermoelastic-transfer-001" and output.resolve() == output
         and not output.exists() and not output.is_symlink(), "Fresh fixed direct case output required")

for name in TRANSFER_FILES:
